shared_elements: a single large anthropomorphic figure dominating the field
low-relief carving on a roughly rectangular slab/block
frontal or profile rendering of a head with marked eyes/facial features
circular/disc-like motif on the body area
justification: Both surfaces are dominated by a single large anthropomorphic figure carved in relief with incised linear detail, and both include roughly circular motifs on the body, but that is about as generic as figural relief gets. A shows a rigid, frontal, extremely schematic human form with abstract geometric bands and discs, while B shows a naturalistic profile bird-headed winged being with anatomically modelled arm, layered feathered wings and curled hair — utterly different conventions, subject and posture.
